top_signals.title: China is defying the global bond yield surge, boosting its diversification appeal
top_signals.summary: Chinese government bond yields have remained low amid a global surge.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Patches a Record 570 Security Flaws
top_signals.summary: Microsoft Corp. today released software updates to plug at least 570 security holes in its Windows operating systems and other software, almost triple the number of vulnerabilities the software giant fixed in its record-smashing Patch Tuesday release last month. Microsoft attributed the burgeoning patch counts to vulnerability discoveries aided by artificial intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Felons, Fraudsters Flog Offensive Cybersecurity Startup
top_signals.summary: A cybersecurity startup dangling millions of dollars to acquire zero-day security vulnerabilities in popular software is run by a pair of far-right conspiracy theorists and convicted felons whose most recent ventures included fake intelligence companies and a now-defunct AI-based lobbying platform they operated under assumed names.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: India’s New Listings Sparkle in a Promising Sign for IPO-Bound NSE
top_signals.summary: A gauge of recent BSE mainboard listings has climbed 16% this year to a record.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Corn Breaks $5 Level as US Crop Tour Points to Tighter Supplies
top_signals.summary: Corn futures topped the $5-a-bushel mark for the first time in 18 months as weaker-than-expected US crop tour results add to global supply concerns for the staple grain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin.com integrates UAE-registered US dollar stablecoin into self-custodial wallet
top_signals.summary: The integration expands access to USDU, the UAE’s first central bank-registered US dollar stablecoin, as it builds distribution beyond institutional channels.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.summary: The combination regimen significantly extended the time patients lived without their melanoma returning, compared with Keytruda alone.
